title: Ingenia Rejects New $1.5 Billion Warburg Pincus Takeover Bid
description: Ingenia Communities Group has rejected a sweetened takeover offer by private equity giant Warburg Pincus and its affiliates, saying the bid undervalues the Australian developer.

title: Musk’s Boring Co. Working on Tunnel to Link Austin, San Antonio
description: Elon Musk said his Boring Co. venture is working on a tunnel project in Texas that would connect the cities of Austin and San Antonio.

title: Citi CEO Sees ‘Tsunami’ of Patching to Secure AI Defense
description: Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser said that companies are racing to build up their defenses on artificial-intelligence models. Speaking on the AI revolution, Fraser said when Mythos came out, “that was not a good day.” She spoke at the 2026 Qatar Economic Forum, UNGA Special Edition; Powered by Bloomberg.   (Source: Bloomberg)
